description: Light single standing on a mown lawn at the street frontage of a walled compound in the Cité Mangou area of Yopougon, about 13 km north-west of the Abidjan air base. Type is single-sourced to a 2019 field note which created no airframe record, so no serial is available and tail_number is blank. Two airframes on maintained grass are visible at the point on Esri GeoEye-1 0.46 m imagery acquired 24 January 2025. Identity provisional.

Second airframe on the same Yopougon lawn, about 25 m from the light single. Identified as a Puma only by the same 2019 field note; the satellite silhouette is not sharp enough to confirm the type independently, no serial is recorded and no variant could be established, so tail_number and variant are blank.
